name: Kinema Curry
steps: Use purchased, properly fermented kinema that is ready to cook; do not attempt a homemade room-temperature fermentation from this curry recipe. Break apart any large sticky clumps with a spoon.
Heat mustard oil until it just begins to smoke, then lower the heat. Add cumin seeds for 20 seconds, followed by onion; cook for 6 minutes until golden.
Stir in ginger, garlic and green chilies for 1 minute. Add turmeric and chopped tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes until the tomatoes collapse into a thick base.
Add kinema and stir-fry for 3 minutes so the fermented soybeans take on the masala. Pour in 300 ml water and add salt.
Simmer uncovered for 8 minutes until the curry is spoonable and the soybeans are heated thoroughly. Sprinkle coriander over the top and serve hot with plain rice.
tips: Kinema has a strong fermented aroma; that is characteristic, but discard it if it smells rotten or shows unfamiliar mold. Buy from a reputable source and keep refrigerated as directed.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
